value.rationale: The interpolation trapezium is a natural positive-area invariant part of a canonical planar PWI. Its complete exact distribution of least periods is an intrinsic observable, rather than an arbitrary restriction: the law quantifies which periods occupy how much of the invariant area and shows unexpected invariance across different cone angles. The size-bias correction is essential and nontrivial; the formula gives meaningful information that an interval-exchange period-set theorem cannot determine alone.
